canonical_campus_key: campuses.id (uuid). Every child table joins on campus_id uuid. No name-based joins required anywhere.

tables.name: campuses
quarantined: derived raw professor count (do not score)

tables.name: campus_systems
tables.note: searchable, NOT selectable; selection resolves to a real campus

tables.name: campus_greek_chapters
tables.grain: 1 row per (campus x greek org) chapter
tables.holds: Greek presence + counts + chapter contact fields
quarantined: count for the 5 wrong-campus campuses in growth_scoring_exclusions
tables.note: council = CAMPUS council (ifc|panhellenic|nphc|mgc). NO dedicated chapter email column.

tables.name: greek_orgs
quarantined: org_type='unknown' (439 rows) — do not assume social
tables.note: council here = NATIONAL conference (NIC/NPC), NOT the campus council. org_type classified by name on NEW inserts; legacy rows unchanged.

tables.name: campus_council_contacts
tables.grain: 1 row per (campus x council_type x email)
tables.note: council_type is a TEXT enum (ifc|panhellenic|nphc|mgc|other), NOT an FK. contact_type: role_inbox|staff_advisor|student_officer|unknown. Campus-level, NOT chapter-level.

tables.name: campus_council_status
tables.holds: per-council discovery status (drives the Enrichment panel)

tables.name: campus_lead_suggestions
quarantined: COUNT(*) as a scoring input (global do-not-score)
count for 7 over-collection campuses in growth_scoring_exclusions
tables.note: filter archived_at IS NULL for active. Professors are the PROFESSOR entity (table name is legacy).

tables.name: growth_scoring_exclusions
tables.holds: scoring exclusion list Growth MUST respect

councils_note: IFC / Panhellenic / NPHC / MGC are NOT tables. They are: (a) council_type values in campus_council_contacts + campus_council_status, and (b) council values in campus_greek_chapters. There is no separate councils table.

campus_fields.label: Greek chapter count
campus_fields.expr: count(campus_greek_chapters where campus_id=? and archived_at is null)
campus_fields.filters: exclude greek_orgs.org_type in (professional,honor,service); exclude if in growth_scoring_exclusions(greek_chapter_count)

campus_fields.label: IFC present
campus_fields.expr: exists(campus_greek_chapters where campus_id=? and council='ifc') OR campus_council_status(council_type='ifc').status='complete'

campus_fields.label: Council contact counts
campus_fields.expr: count(campus_council_contacts where campus_id=? group by council_type)

campus_fields.label: Professor count
campus_fields.expr: count(campus_lead_suggestions where campus_id=? and archived_at is null)
campus_fields.display_rule: DISPLAY ONLY, label 'directory-scraped, may include non-accounting'; show quarantine warning if in growth_scoring_exclusions

campus_fields.label: Intro-1 professor count
campus_fields.expr: count(campus_lead_suggestions where campus_id=? and archived_at is null and (rmp_target_course_counts_json->>'intro_1')::int >= 1)

chapter_fields.path: NOT AVAILABLE — no chapter email column; campus_council_contacts is campus-level not chapter-level. Weak point / augment later.
